4222-5268-8230.easyPrerequisites: Seedship Agrarian doesn't have summoning sickness.
4222-5268-8230.description:
Activate Seedship Agrarian by tapping it, adding {U}.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

2577-4699-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-4699-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2486-2511-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-2511-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1.

1003-4053-4247-6989.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1325-5147-5170-6132.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-4808-7895.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Black Lotus.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Little Bear.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1308-4772-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Anointed Procession and Doubling Season.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1308-4772-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

4200-6626-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

147-2292-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
147-2292-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

687-1669-2404-6099.notablePrerequisites:
There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
You control at least three creatures.
687-1669-2404-6099.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Gaea's Cradle enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
687-1669-2404-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

2231-2438-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-2438-4871-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

630-1115-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-1115-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-3490-5870-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-5870-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-3622-4067-6281.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Gravedigger.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Gravedigger that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Gravedigger token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gravedigger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

645-1267-2921-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2921-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

2906-4484-4871-5643-6797.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2906-4484-4871-5643-6797.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2906-4484-4871-5643-6797.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2906-4484-4871-5643-6797.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

394-856-5226-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1018-1987-3277-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1018-1987-3277-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Skullwinder and Izzet Chronarch.
When Skullwinder and Izzet Chronarch enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-3277-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

1912-3088-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith and Xenic Poltergiest do not have summoning sickness.
1912-3088-4131.description:
Activate Xenic Poltergeist by tapping it, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

133-2136-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
133-2136-2178.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Satyr Hedonist with haste.
Activate a Satyr Hedonist token by paying {R} and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
When the Satyr Hedonist token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2 for each remaining Satyr Hedonist token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Satyr Hedonist tokens and/or target any other creature.

678-1636-4336-5098.notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
678-1636-4336-5098.description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Repeat.

800-913-2470-4893.description:
Activate Grand Architect's second ability by tapping Knacksaw Clique, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Knacksaw Clique by paying {U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponents library and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

2499-2682-4475.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least three.
2499-2682-4475.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve the first Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
Resolve the second Dire Fleet Ravager trigger, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1636-4474-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4474-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
The Human Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
